title: Single-Engine Discrete-Event Simulator
description: Models one system as timestamped events processed in chronological order, the workhorse pattern behind queueing, logistics, and network simulations. Arrivals, service completions, and state changes are drawn from seeded random streams so every run is exactly reproducible.
architecture: A priority queue holds pending events; a state vector is mutated by event handlers; the clock jumps to the next event time.
acceptance_tests: Re-running the demo with the same seed reproduces identical metrics, and average wait stays within the theoretical M/M/c band.

title: Monte Carlo Parameter Sweeper
description: Runs the same simulation hundreds of times with sampled parameter values to map how outputs respond to uncertain inputs. Histograms of the results replace single-point guesses with honest distributions.
architecture: A sampler draws parameter vectors from declared distributions; a worker pool executes runs; an aggregator builds empirical distributions.
acceptance_tests: The demo's measured distribution mean converges toward the analytic expectation as the run count grows.

title: Assumption Ledger and Audit Trail
